name: Pi
summary: Personal AI chat assistant from Inflection AI, designed for open-ended conversation.
description: Pi is a personal AI assistant developed by Inflection AI. It is designed for open-ended, supportive conversation rather than task automation, and users can talk to it on the web or in its mobile apps after signing up. The service presents itself with the line "Hey, I'm Pi — your personal AI". Pi is free on the web and in mobile apps; Inflection applies message-rate limits for heavy use and does not publish a paid consumer subscription.
